title: Made for Giving: pop-up gift shop
summary: Two-week pop-up shop of original gifts from 20 local artists, makers and designers, with a launch evening from 6pm to 8pm on Thursday 26 November.

title: Trees R Good @ Stella Dore Gallery
summary: Stella Dore’s Christmas show features work by Grow Up Art, Haus of Lucy, Shuby and others. The exhibition opens with a private viewing on 27 November.

title: Amuse Bouche comedy writing taster
venue: Downstairs bar, White Rock Hotel, Hastings
summary: A female-powered introductory workshop in comedy writing, ad libbing, improv and flash fiction, run by Lindsay Jayne, Nicky Torode, Nicola Reading and Stella Valente. No experience needed, just a sense of humour.

title: Christmas Tree Festival, St Clements Church
venue: St Clements Church, Hastings Old Town
summary: Decorated trees themed 'Christmas Characters', a craft fair and refreshments open the festival, which runs until 6 December with trees by treelight, handbells, border Morris and live music.

title: TAKE ME TO CHURCH
summary: More Fountains and Metalheadz team up for a Blue Note Session featuring DJ Storm, Dillinja, Loxy and Elm Street in an acoustic church space.

title: Ben Maier & the Maier Brothers
summary: Hastings singer-songwriter Ben Maier is joined by his brothers for a one-off family performance at Mike's Shop.

title: NORTHERN SOUL DAY PARTY
summary: The Northern Soul Day Party comes to Blackbox for an afternoon of rare soul records and dance floor favourites. Tickets are available from £12.50.

title: Hastings Makers Market
summary: Browse 50-ish stalls for vintage homeware, handmade ceramics and dog treats, with resident studios open to meet the makers. Food, coffee and live music are on site.

title: Adrian Cox Trio
summary: Internationally acclaimed clarinetist Adrian Cox performs New Orleans music with his trio, featuring guitarist Honey Boulton and bassist Alex Gilson.

title: St Leonards Frost Fair 2026
summary: Join the parade and get into the festive spirit with free entry. The event features entertainment, over 30 market stalls and local independent shops.

title: Blackbox Presents: DAVE PEARCE – Trance Anthems
summary: Dave Pearce, the creator of BBC Radio 1’s Dance Anthems, performs an extended set of uplifting and anthemic big room music. He is joined by Mark Dickson, Skie, Kel and Sweeney.

title: St Leonards Church Indoor Market
summary: An indoor market taking place in an extraordinary historic space on London Road, just a couple of minutes from Warrior Square station.

title: Makers & Bakers Christmas Market at St Andrews Mews
summary: A market taking place in the small and interesting mews arcade, which is home to shops, cafes and galleries.

title: Hastings Makers Market at The Yard
summary: A market featuring a large collection of independent retailers and studios.

title: Christmas Fayre
venue: Hastings & St Leonards Angling Association, Hastings
summary: A Christmas fayre featuring crafts and handmade gifts. Everyone is welcome to attend.

title: Hastings Makers Market
summary: Browse 50-ish stalls for vintage homeware, handmade ceramics and homemade dog treats. The resident studios are open to meet the makers, with food, coffee and live music on site.
